trap.label: in accordance with
trap.wrong: The contract was signed in accordance to the law.
trap.right: The contract was signed in accordance with the law.
trap.why: Em português “de acordo com” leva a/com. O aluno copia to. Em inglês, in accordance with.

fix.wrong: The notice shall deemed received on day two.
fix.right: The notice shall be deemed received on day two.

fix.wrong: Notwithstanding of the foregoing, the clause applies.
fix.right: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the clause applies.

fix.wrong: The agreement is made in triplicates.
fix.right: The agreement is made in triplicate.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in accordance with: “According to the law, the notice is valid.”
rewrite.answer: In accordance with the law, the notice is valid.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com shall be deemed: “The notice will be treated as received.”
rewrite.answer: The notice shall be deemed received.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com notwithstanding: “Despite the foregoing, the clause applies.”
rewrite.answer: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the clause applies.
